conflicts.fact: Which practical/dataset Lesson 4 contains: starch test vs Elodea oxygen-bubble experiment
conflicts.versions: Lesson 4 is a starch test on a variegated/covered leaf with no Elodea or bubble counts; Lesson 5 says it builds on Lesson 4's Elodea oxygen-bubble data table at different light intensities. Lesson 7 is where the bubble-count investigation is actually done.

conflicts.fact: When the cumulative photosynthesis model was started
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 starts a model ('My Starting Model'); Lesson 3 calls a fresh page 'Version 1'; Lesson 5 says model begun in Lesson 3 and that in Lesson 4 it showed chloroplast as black box; Lesson 4 model is a leaf zone annotation, not a chloroplast; Lesson 9 says begun in Lesson 1; Lesson 8 says built across Lessons 3-7.

conflicts.fact: Whether stomata close at night / mechanism of overnight recovery vs. what Lesson 7 says is the phenomenon explanation
conflicts.versions: Lesson 2 and 10 attribute wilting to stomata opening for gas exchange with transpiration exceeding xylem supply; Lesson 7 says the wilting puzzle is unexplained and will be addressed in Lesson 10, ignoring Lessons 2 and 3 which already explained it.
Lesson 3 and Lesson 2 explain wilting via stomata/transpiration; Lesson 7 says water movement is a missing piece to be addressed in Lesson 10.

conflicts.fact: Cause of the plateau/limiting factors and temperature optimum
conflicts.versions: Lesson 7 says the plateau is due to CO2 or temperature; Lesson 8 temperature data peaks ~35 °C with denaturation above ~40 °C, while Dataset B says sharp decline after 35 °C peak. Also Lesson 8 graphs said 'three graphs' per group but two plotted.
